name: Study Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Admission confirmed by a recognized Pakistani university or educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission at a recognized Pakistani institution.

requirements.blocker_text: The admitting university's International Student Office must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Higher Education Commission (HEC) on the student's behalf before a study visa can be processed.
requirements.fix_path: Have the university's International Student Office submit the NOC request to HEC (nocforeign@hec.gov.pk); HEC states a 5-working-day processing time for a complete application.

requirements.blocker_text: Security agency clearance is required before a study visa/extension is issued.

evidence_required.document: HEC No Objection Certificate (submitted by university, not the student directly)

outcome.duration_length: Up to 2 years after security clearance (per Ministry of Interior policy); consolidated visa reform lists study visa validity as issued for 2 years

sources.title: Higher Education Commission of Pakistan -- Grant of No Objection Certificate (NOC) to Foreign Students: the request must be initiated by the admitting university's International Student Office (not the student), submitted with duly verified documents; HEC processing time is 5 working days from receipt of a complete application

Directorate General of Immigration & Passports (Ministry of Interior) -- Visa Categories: Study Visa now issued for 2 years after due clearance by security agencies within a stipulated 30-day window; requires Ministry NOC and security clearance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Published on tier-1 sourcing (HEC + DGI&P, both government bodies). Distinctive procedural feature: the NOC request must be filed BY THE UNIVERSITY on the student's behalf -- HEC explicitly discourages direct student inquiries and will not action a request the student submits themselves. family_can_work left null (schema-nullable) since no source addressed dependents at all for this route.
